description: This file defines the RAGFlowConfig class, which configures and manages API interactions with a RAGFlow service that provides OpenAI-compatible chat and agent endpoints. It includes methods for parsing model names, constructing API URLs, environment validation, and request transformation specific to the RAGFlow API structure.

classes.name: RAGFlowConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for RAGFlow's OpenAI-compatible API, handling model parsing, URL construction, environment validation, and request transformation tailored for RAGFlow's endpoint structures.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str,str] _parse_ragflow_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Parses a model name string formatted as 'ragflow/{endpoint_type}/{id}/{model_name}' to extract endpoint type, id, and model name.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL based on the model's endpoint type (chat or agent) and optional base URL.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str],str] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], custom_llm_provider: str, )
methods.description: Retrieves provider info such as API base URL, API key, and provider name, parsing model to extract actual model name.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and sets up request headers, including authorization, based on environment variables or parameters.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms request parameters, mainly ensuring the correct model name is used within the request.
